board.note: 6 mm plywood, 120 × 180 mm. Clamp upright; do not operate flat.

rod-clamp.note: 4.2 mm rod bore; two M3 mount holes; tap central top hole M3 for a rod-retaining screw.

dancer-slider.note: Two 4.3 mm rod bores. Central M3 pulley axle and lower M3 attachment for a hanging mass; measure total moving mass.

guide-rod.note: 4 mm smooth rod × 147 mm; two required; deburr ends.

pulley.note: 20 mm groove diameter; 10.15 mm × 4.15 mm seat for a 623 bearing. Check actual bearing and printed fit.

pulley-retainer.note: Bond only the outer annulus to pulley back after fitting bearing; do not bond bearing races or seal.

623-bearing.note: 623 bearing envelope: 3 × 10 × 4 mm; SKF catalogue reference in the guide.

fixed-axle-post.note: Spacers for fixed return pulley and output eye, from board front to bearing inner-race spacer.

moving-axle-post.note: Spacer from slider front to bearing inner-race spacer.

inner-race-shim.note: 0.25 mm inner-race shim, 4.2 mm OD; use measured metal stock.

axle-washer.note: Small washer contacting only the bearing inner race; 5 mm OD.

guide-eye.note: Smooth ceramic guide eye envelope; procure to measured bore and mounting size.

eye-holder.note: Ceramic eye cup, axis along Y. Bond ceramic in 8.15 mm seat; captured M3 nut at the board-facing base. Fit a rear M3 × 10 bolt.

bench-bobbin.note: 26 mm flanges, 39 mm total height, 6.4 mm spindle bore; print in two pieces or support the upper flange.

bobbin-base.note: M6 axle stand-off from board to the felt washer.

felt-brake.note: 1 mm felt washer; friction is to be measured, not assumed.

brake-spring.note: Compression spring envelope only; measure preload and resulting torque.

M6-spindle.note: M6 smooth-shank bolt/spindle; 70 mm reference length, retain at board and adjust brake preload.

M6-nut.note: M6 adjustment nut envelope; threads and flats not represented.

M3-fixed-axle.note: M3 × 40 fixed pulley axle, with locknut and inner-race washers.

M3-moving-axle.note: M3 × 25 moving pulley axle, with locknut and inner-race washers.
